meta.title: WNG chart of accounts — redesigned Finance posting map (D3, Option A)
meta.chart_evidence: wng_source_rehearsal.chart_of_accounts — 120 WNG QuickBooks accounts (created 2026-03-06) + 3 inserted by target migrations (2160, 7150, 7550)
meta.status: PROPOSED — NOT accountant-approved. Nothing here is active until an approved line is copied into config/finance_accounts.php `map` (functions/catalogue) or set on the paying-accounts screen (payment sources).

classifications.EXACT_MATCH: Existing WNG account already satisfies the requirement (same accounting meaning); only the map line is needed.
classifications.SUITABLE_EXISTING: A WNG account appears suitable; accountant confirmation required.
classifications.CONFIGURATION_CHANGE_ONLY: Correct account exists; a Finance configuration record (not the code map) must point at it.
classifications.NEW_SUB_ACCOUNT: Correct parent/category exists but no sufficiently specific posting account.
classifications.ACCOUNTANT_DECISION: Accounting treatment cannot be determined safely from repository evidence.

bank_default.rationale: Default operating bank for payments with no paying account; the seeded operating source is 'Equity Bank – Operating Account'. Confirm Equity is the operating account.

accounts_receivable.rationale: 'Accounts Receivable (A/R)'. AR-002 (EUR) is a foreign-currency ledger; the redesigned ERP invoices in KES only.

staff_advances.rationale: Staff imprest is a receivable from staff. 'Short Term Debtors' (STD-001) is the nearest parent; a specific 'Staff Advances' sub-account is recommended rather than mixing imprest with trade debtors.

input_vat.rationale: No VAT asset/control account among the 120. WNG pays VAT penalties (VP-001), so QuickBooks almost certainly has a VAT control account that was not imported. Accountant to confirm VAT registration and supply the account.

inventory.rationale: No inventory ASSET among the 120 (INV-001 is 'Inventory Shrinkage', an expense; COS-001 'Change in inventory - COS'). Petty-cash history codes spend to 'Inventory Asset', so the QuickBooks account exists but was not imported. Also a treatment decision: the redesign keeps perpetual stock (receipt debits inventory, issue credits it).

wip_direct_materials.rationale: WNG has no WIP. Mapping WIP to cost of sales changes WHEN cost hits P&L (on capture rather than on job completion). Candidate if WIP is not kept: COS-008 Cost of Sales:Materials.

wip_direct_labour.rationale: W7 Finance verify posts direct labour here (expense code DL-CAS-001). Candidates: PE-007 Personnel Expenses:Wages-Direct Labour, or QuickBooks 'Direct Labor' (seen in history, not imported). Same WIP timing decision.

wip_subcontractors.rationale: Candidate: COS-020 Subcontractors - COS. WIP timing decision.

wip_transport_logistics.rationale: Candidate: COS-016 Cost of Sales:Transport & Delivery (fuel COS-009 and parking COS-011 are WNG's finer split). WIP timing decision.

wip_equipment_site.rationale: No cost-of-sales equipment account (OPE-013 Equipment Rental is opex). WIP timing decision.

wip_project_utilities.rationale: No cost-of-sales utilities account (UTIL-001 and OPE-012 are opex). WIP timing decision.

wip_project_facilitation.rationale: Candidate: COS-006 Cost of Sales:Field Facilitation (WNG also splits COS-014 Team Meals, COS-015 Teams accommodation). WIP timing decision.

wip_venue_statutory.rationale: No cost-of-sales venue/statutory account (OPE-017 Licenses and permits is opex). WIP timing decision.

wip_rework_warranty.rationale: Nearest: COS-018 Other - COS. WIP timing decision.

output_vat.rationale: No VAT liability account among the 120; see input_vat.

wht_payable.rationale: No withholding-tax liability account among the 120.

paye_payable.rationale: No payroll liability accounts among the 120, but petty-cash history codes to 'Payroll liabilities:Net Pay' and ':Helb Repayment' and 'SHIF' — they exist in QuickBooks and were not imported.

net_payroll_payable.rationale: QuickBooks 'Payroll liabilities:Net Pay'. Note: account 2160 'Net Payroll Payable' in the rehearsal chart was inserted by target migration 2026_08_24_000001, not by WNG.

accrued_expenses.rationale: No accrued-liabilities / goods-received-not-invoiced account. Needed by GRN accruals and voucher liability allocation.

client_deposits.rationale: No customer-deposit liability. Accountant: are deposits recognised as liabilities until invoiced?

opening_balance_equity.rationale: 'Opening Balance Equity' (used by opening stock counts).

project_revenue.rationale: No income account among the 120 except RI-001 Return Inwards. History codes to 'Sales:Printing', so QuickBooks income accounts exist and were not imported. The chart export must be completed before W1 can post.

cos_direct_materials.rationale: WIP release target. Only relevant if WIP is kept.

cos_direct_labour.rationale: WIP release target and payroll direct labour: PE-007 Personnel Expenses:Wages-Direct Labour.

inventory_adjustments.rationale: INV-001 Inventory Shrinkage fits count losses; count GAINS also post here — confirm one account for both directions.

salaries_expense.rationale: PE-006 Personnel Expenses:Salaries. 7550 'Salaries & Wages' in the rehearsal chart was inserted by a target migration and duplicates it.

bank_charges.rationale: FIN-003 Finance cost:Bank charges. WNG separates FIN-005 Mpesa charges; the redesign posts all fees to one account — confirm or split by paying account.

1600.rationale: No fixed-asset accounts among the 120 ('Office Improvement' appears in history, not imported; ADM-003 depreciation exists with no asset).

2300.rationale: No loan liability among the 120 (FK-001 Faulu Kenya is recorded as an asset).

6100.rationale: Operating Expenses:Electricity & Water. Reference treats it as production overhead; WNG as opex.

6600.rationale: No safety/PPE account; nearest OPE-006 Consumables.

7100.rationale: Rent & lease Payments; WNG books electricity separately (OPE-012).

7150.rationale: Stationery & Printing (or OPE-019 Office expenses). 7150 in the rehearsal chart was inserted by migration 2026_09_07_000002.

BANK-MAIN.rationale: Equity Bank – Operating Account → Equity Bank.

AP.rationale: Supplier credit (payable source, cannot pay) → Accounts Payable.

MPESA.rationale: No M-Pesa balance account among the 120 (only FIN-005 Mpesa charges). Is the M-Pesa till a separate asset, or does it settle through a bank?

CARD.rationale: Which account settles company-card spend (a card liability, or the bank it draws on)?

unassigned_wng_cash_accounts.CASH-001: Cash Account — not a paying source today
unassigned_wng_cash_accounts.FK-001: Faulu Kenya (asset) — bank/microfinance? not a paying source
unassigned_wng_cash_accounts.NIC-001: NIC Dollar Account — USD; the ERP is KES-only

pnl_sections.rule: ProfitAndLossService sections expenses by account_type (direct_cost | overhead | opex); all 120 WNG accounts have account_type NULL, so every WNG expense would show as UNCLASSIFIED. Proposed backfill, for accountant approval:
pnl_sections.balance_sheet: asset/liability/equity accounts; normal_balance: asset=debit, liability/equity/revenue=credit, expense=debit
